name: Payload sweep, two stages
description: How much can the two-stage rocket carry to orbit? Up to about 2.5 t; the same rocket in one stage manages under 1 t. Beyond that it runs short, and the heavier rocket also climbs more slowly off the pad, so the same tilt turns it over sooner: at 4 t it falls back. (The kick is 18° here, a little gentler than the default, for the heavier loads.)
